You don't have to contact the coach each time you want to know how your kid's training is going. The Parent App gives you a good overview of training schedules, attendance, coach's contacts, etc.
GET A GOOD OVERVIEW
• Schedule updates - schedules and schedule updates always on your phone
• Mark availability (RSVP) - let the coach know if your kid will be participating
• Attendance report - keep an eye on your kid's absence
• Organize carpooling - see who else has RSVP-d to a workout or game and contact them easily
• Coach's contact info - reach your kid's coach by email or phone
• Update profile - keep the coach up to date with emergency contact information

REQUIREMENTS
• You don't need to sign up. Just verify with your email.
• Your kid's coach needs to be on Sportlyzer. Over 19,000 coaches are already saving time and energy thanks to Sportlyzer.

PART OF A BIGGER SOFTWARE PLATFORM
Sportlyzer Parent App is part of Sportlyzer’s software platform for sports clubs that provides smart, automated solutions for coaches, club managers, athletes and parents. Everyone and everything is centrally connected through Sportlyzer.
